title: Chapter 1066
text:
Character Summon Card – 'Void Overlord' Kasuyi: [Artificial Psychic Undercurrent] – Uses a large range psychic attack to form a long-term offensive psychic undercurrent. Can be simply controlled. Will deal multiple damage to all living targets in the area. Three damage tests per second. Base damage per test is (INT + MYS) x 1.8. At the same time, it has 170% Psychic Resistance Penetration and a random chance to inflict a negative mental status on the target. Uses: 0/2

If the test fails, 500,000 – 800,000 True Damage will be dealt to the target. Uses: 0/2

Character Summon Card – 'Beast Ancestor' Gorután: [Body of the Beast Ancestor] – + 20% STR, + 20% DEX, + 40% END, + 300% Pugilist Flame damage, + 2.5% HP recovery per second. This effect is not affected by combat status. Uses: 0/2

Character Summon Card – 'Goddess of Death' Hella: [Revival of Death Resistance] – When your HP reaches zero, you will be immune to this death and immediately recover twenty-five to fifty percent of your HP. At the same time, you will refresh your status. This ability can be given to other life forms, but it can only be effective once on the same target. Uses: 0/6

"Wow, this batch of goods is good!"

After looking at the effects of each Character Summon Card, Han Xiao could not help but be overjoyed.

As expected of someone with pinnacle Beyond Grade A and Super High Risk Esper Abilities, the quality was very high.

The Kasuyi Character Summon Card was a pure attack skill, and its basic attack power was not bad. Han Xiao's current Intelligence and Mystery attribute added together was close to 30,000, and multiplied by 1.8, it would be more than 50,000 basic damage. If it was judged three times per second, it would be around 150,000 theoretical damage. Moreover, the 170% Spirit Penetration could greatly weaken the effect of the target's Psychic Barrier. If it encountered a weaker opponent, it could even deal damage that was close to True Damage.

If it was just a one-time psychic attack, it would not be a big deal. The power of this Character Summon Card was that it could create a destructive psychic current, and this thing would not dissipate easily. As long as it was controlled well, it would be equivalent to having a large moving circle on the battlefield, causing continuous psychic damage. Calculating it this way, the damage would be off the charts.

Sierron's Character Summon Card was also an attack skill. However, unlike Kasuyi's AOE skill, this was a single target attack. Needless to say, the Judgement of Death was extremely powerful. The only downside was that the conditions were too harsh. However, the True Damage after failing the Judgement was also very high. If he could deal the highest 800,000 True Damage each time, he would be able to send Sisko to hell in just a few hits.

However, this skill would not be very effective against targets who were immune to True Damage. If Sierron used this ability on me, it would be no different from tickling me …

"The single target damage of a peak Pugilist is still very strong against a proper Beyond Grade A." Han Xiao nodded.

Gorután's Character Summon Card was an all-rounded buff. It was very effective and very suitable for Pugilists. It was also useful for Han Xiao. The basic attribute buff and recovery bonus would be of some help to him.

The last thing that surprised Han Xiao the most was Hella's Character Summon Card. This was the effect of [Instant Death Immunity] after it was upgraded, which was equivalent to a chance to be reborn. Even though he was very tanky right now, this Character Summon Card still gave him a layer of insurance.

The shocking thing was that it could actually give others the chance to resist death, making them immune to death once.

The Character Summon Card was the embodiment of the character's ability, which meant that Hella herself had such an ability. However, Han Xiao had seen her interface before. She clearly did not give others the ability to resist death.

"Could it be that this battle forced out her potential and allowed her to awaken a new use for her Esper Ability?"

Han Xiao guessed. Based on the actual situation, the possibility was not small.

In this battle, Hella and Aurora had established a Distance Less Connection. Perhaps the appearance of this ability had something to do with that. It was not hard to explain why Hella did not have this ability in his previous life.

Outsiders could only be revived once and could not be revived by Hella indefinitely. However, at least they had an extra life, which was great news for the officers of the Black Star Corps.

"I used quite a number of Character Summon Cards this time, including Sisko, Ames, Mecha Empire, and Yin Ying. I only used Perfect Mechanical Sense and Polar Channel Flow, and the blank Character Summon Card rewarded by this mission can make up for the double Perfect Mechanical Sense. Therefore, I only lost one Tyrant Character Summon Card. Now that I have obtained four Character Summon Cards, it can be considered as breaking even."

Han Xiao's face was filled with joy.

The Character Summon Cards were just the appetizer, and it had already allowed him to break even. The chance to draw abilities was the real deal, which was pure profit.

He suppressed his excitement and nervousness and looked at the notification on the interface.

Additional Mission Requirements Completed.

This time, he had captured five people — Tolaen, Womre, Jackornitz, Hades, and Gorután. They were all targets of the Mage, Mechanic, Pugilist, and Psychic systems.

Although their average strength was not as good as the four of them, the abilities he would draw were permanent.

Two of them were noobs, but they were still Beyond Grade A, so there was still a chance for him to draw a good ability.

"Rice has to be eaten one bite at a time, and the road has to be taken one step at a time. The best should be left for last."

Han Xiao hesitated for a moment before deciding to start with the noobs.

Hint: Hades is a Psychic. Some of the available abilities have been automatically adjusted according to your class.

Randomizing … complete.

Please select one from the following five abilities as the reward:

1. [Will Resistance] – Ability: + 35% Abnormal Mental State Resistance. Cost: none. Cooldown: 160s.

2. [Calm and Composed] – Talent: + 200 INT, + 200 MYS.

3. [Energy Manipulation Mastery] – Talent: -25% Energy.

4. [Strengthening Mental Barrier] – Talent: + 120% Mental Damage Resistance, + 50% Abnormal Mental State Resistance.

5. [Squeezing Energy Recovery] – Ability: Consumes 20,000-50,000 HP, recovers the same amount of Energy, and temporarily reduces Energy Cost by 15%. Cooldown: 330s.

Since Hades was a Psychic, most of the abilities he had drawn were related to the mental state. This was within Han Xiao's expectations.

Since he did not get any powerful abilities, Han Xiao was not discouraged. He took it as a last resort.

Picking the best out of the worst, he directly chose [Strengthening Mental Barrier]. In terms of effect alone, this ability was not bad. It could be considered a high-level mental ability.

Over the years, Han Xiao had consciously made up for his shortcomings in mental state and had accumulated a lot of resistance. However, when he saw the Kasuyi Character Summon Card just now, he knew that his current mental resistance was still not enough in front of someone of Kasuyi's level.

Now that he had obtained a new mental resistance ability with excellent effects, it could be considered as making up for the gap.

After calming himself down, Han Xiao continued to draw the ability of the next person.

Hint: Tolaen is a Mage. Some of the available abilities have been automatically adjusted according to your class.

Randomizing … complete.

Please select one from the following five abilities as the reward:

1. [Advanced Energy Sense] – Talent: Greatly increases the ability to sense all kinds of energy. You can see more details that others cannot.

2. [Magic Insulation] – Ability: When receiving magical attacks, the actual damage you receive is reduced by 22%. The duration of magical control skills on you is reduced by 17%.

3. [Super Overload] – Talent: Your body can withstand a stronger load. The effects of certain buff skills are extended on you. + 1,500 END and + 15% Health.

4. [Melee Skills] – Talent: You have mastered a large number of melee skills. Your attacks can occasionally cause a cleave effect. + 34% Melee Damage, + 20% Critical Hit, + 28% Block Rate, + 23% Dodge Rate, + 300 DEX.

5. [Lightning Mastery] – Ability: Greatly increases Lightning and Electromagnetic Affinity.

"… Sure enough, demons who don't learn melee skills aren't decent Mages."

Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

Of these five options, [Advanced Energy Sense] was basically an essential ability for all Beyond Grade A Mages. Any abnormal energy fluctuations could not escape their eyes. [Magic Insulation] and [Super Overload] were abilities for buff Mages like Tolaen. His body had to withstand a large number of enchantments to maintain the effect of the buff spells.

Without much hesitation, Han Xiao directly chose [Super Overload]. This was the most suitable ability for him, and the buff was quite considerable.

These 1,500 END made up for the gap. As long as he took out a portion of his Free Attribute Points and threw them into END, he would be able to surpass the 15,000 mark. In the future, he would be able to obtain an additional God's Trait Transformation Point every time he advanced.

After this battle, Han Xiao discovered that the most important factor in widening the gap between peak Beyond Grade As was the degree of God's Trait Transformation. Although his way of leveling up was different from others, the more God's Trait Transformation Points he had, the better.

Han Xiao took a liking to this ability at first glance, mainly because of the effect of increasing his energy limit.

His current energy was about 180,000. With this increase, he could immediately increase his energy by tens of thousands, which was one of the abilities that he was in dire need of.

Not only did it increase the limit of his energy points, but it also increased his energy level by at least one level, which was equivalent to a few thousand Attribute Points.

This talent was a percentage increase, and the better the foundation, the better the effect. It was a growth talent, and the way he saw it, it was almost as good as half a Molding Talent.

Furthermore, Cell Activity was related to his lifespan, so this talent might even have a + 1s hidden effect.

The fourth choice was Jackornitz. His class matched, so he could draw even more abilities.

As a Mechanic, Mechanical Pugilists tended to use machinery to fight, and they were proficient in using 'tools', so they had many unique talents.

Although this talent was a Mechanic class ability, under normal circumstances, only Mechanical Pugilists could awaken it. Because it was also a Mechanic talent, it was chosen by Han Xiao.

Many of the abilities of Mechanical Pugilists directly increased their utilization of machinery. Obtaining this ability would increase his strength tremendously, and the melee damage of the Mech Legion would skyrocket.

Furthermore, Han Xiao had tested it before. The Mechanical Deity was a special type of combined machinery, but because the core of the combined machinery had to be the main body or the Lord's Avatar, it was a mechanical equipment item on the interface, which meant that it could share the bonuses of mechanical equipment.

This way, the actual combat strength of the Mechanical Deity would receive a terrifying bonus, and its power would increase by a level. Under normal conditions, the Mechanical Deity would have the combat strength of double Mechanical Sense mode!

"This is good stuff. If I can obtain the unique talents of Mechanical Pugilists and Launchers, the combat strength of my Mech Legion will probably increase by a few levels." Han Xiao rubbed his hands together, his heart itching.

Randomizing … complete.

1. [Energy Shock] – Ability: Use energy to shock the opponent, causing the opponent to enter a temporary state of stiffness.

2. [Microscopic Molt] – Ability: Refresh yourself, dispel all negative statuses. Cooldown: 400s.

3. [Energy Backflow] – Talent: Every time you hit the target in melee, you can recover 40% of the energy used in the attack while dealing normal damage.

4. [Block Penetration] – Talent: Even if the target blocks your melee attack, they will still receive 30% – 80% of the damage.
